Productivity vs quality is sometimes framed as a tradeoff. They're not seeing it.

生产力和质量有时被视为一种权衡取舍。但他们并不这么认为。

tweetHighlights.originalTitle: A founder kept saying "if only we had money we'd do X." Money is not the fire.
tweetHighlights.originalBody:
A founder kept saying "if only we had money we'd do X."

Money is not the fire. Money is gasoline you pour on a fire that already exists.

You don't have a funding problem. You have a "people don't want it yet" problem. Go make the first fire.
tweetHighlights.translatedTitle: 一位创始人一直说“如果我们有钱，我们就会做X”。但金钱并非关键所在。
tweetHighlights.translatedBody:
一位创始人总是说“要是我们有钱，我们就能做X了。”

钱不是火。钱是汽油，你往已经存在的火上浇油。

你不是缺钱，而是缺“人们还没想要”。去点燃第一把火吧。

tweetHighlights.originalBody:
The teams seeing the biggest wins from AI are completely changing how they work, not speeding up what they already do. What steps can you delete, what handoffs go away, what can an agent just own end to end. Great to see Salesforce go this deep. Shoutout to Srini, @Benioff & team.

Full writeup: https://t.co/3Rbdj9K8YN

tweetHighlights.translatedBody:
那些从人工智能中获益最大的团队正在彻底改变他们的工作方式，而不是仅仅加快现有流程。哪些步骤可以省略？哪些交接环节可以取消？哪些环节可以由客服人员全权负责？很高兴看到 Salesforce 在这方面投入如此之多。特别感谢 Srini、@Benioff 和他们的团队。

完整报道：https://t.co/3Rbdj9K8YN
